title: Self-Pay Visit Package Refund Ceiling: Reinstated Packages and Received Visits
content:
**Refund controls — Self-Pay Visit Package.** The unused-visit cap limits what is refunded for the price — the money paid toward the price less the value of the visits used — to the visits standing on the package multiplied by the purchase price divided by the visits purchased, taken at **80 percent** where the package has been reinstated and in full where the package holds visits it received by transfer; any other package has no such cap. The cap applies to that difference before any fee or charge is subtracted from the refund.

**Reading the package history**

- *Reinstated:* the history carries a visit credit for a reinstatement. This reading governs where the package also holds visits received by transfer.
- *Holds visits received by transfer:* the history carries a visit credit received by transfer.
- *Visits standing:* the visits credited less the visits used, forfeited, expired, transferred and refunded.

| Package history shows | Cap on the refund for the price |
|---|---|
| a reinstatement credit | visits standing, multiplied by purchase price divided by visits purchased, at 80 percent |
| no reinstatement credit; a credit received by transfer | visits standing, multiplied by purchase price divided by visits purchased, in full |
| neither | no such cap |

**Worked ceiling (hypothetical reinstated package: purchase price $856.00 for 8 visits, money paid toward the price $856.00, 2 visits used valued at $125.00, 6 visits standing)**

- Money paid toward the price less the value of the visits used: $856.00 less $250.00, $606.00.
- Cap: 6 visits at $107.00 is $642.00; at 80 percent, $513.60.
- What is refunded for the price is the lower figure, $513.60.
